summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Merma (Waste) Propagation in Recipe Cost Calculations (Iteration 157). All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Critical validation confirmed: (1) Recipe POST without waste_factor_pct uses ingredient's yield_waste_percent as fallback (8% → $0.54), (2) Recipe with explicit waste_factor_pct=0 overrides to no waste ($0.50), (3) Recipe with waste_factor_pct=15 overrides to 15% ($0.575). cost-preview endpoint also correctly handles all waste scenarios.
